description: This file defines an Enyo kind called 'ToDo.NotepadHeaderView', representing a header component for a to-do list application, including a form with an input field for adding new tasks.

classes.name: ToDo.NotepadHeaderView
classes.description: An Enyo kind that sets up the header section with a title and input form for new to-do items.

methods.name: saveNew
methods.description: Handles the keypress event in the input field, detecting the ENTER key to trigger saving a new to-do item and preventing default form submission.
